kernel: five-point stencil, four additions plus multiply by 0.2
assumption: Five 8-byte loads and one 8-byte store per interior output; no neighbor cache re-use accounted for. This is an upper bound on per-output traffic and gives a lower-bound AI.
roofline_classification: Cannot determine quantitative Roofline regime without measured or manufacturer-specified bandwidth and peak FLOP/s. Low arithmetic intensity makes bandwidth limitation plausible.
weak_scaling_formula_used: P * work_1 * T_weak_1 / (work_P * T_weak_P); exactly as written in the handout
caution: The handout expression is NOT conventional Gustafson speedup; it may decrease as 1/P for ideal constant weak-scaling runtime. Results report the specified metric without relabeling it.
regime: memory-bound (provisional; hardware peak bandwidth and FLOP/s not established)
